verdict.rationale: Datadog's Agent Observability Experiments feature documents creating and versioning datasets and comparing experiment results to see how prompt, model, or provider changes affect performance. That covers offline evaluation against datasets. Its managed evaluations attach to production spans, but the evidence never shows datasets being curated from production traces. missing for 10: documented trace-to-dataset curation (adding production spans/traces to a dataset), detail on how offline experiment evaluators run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: It helps you understand how changes to prompts, models, providers, or system architecture affect performance.
Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
